ex.en: The city faces a chronic shortage of affordable housing.
ex.zh: 这座城市长期缺乏可负担的住房。

words.note: chronic 指长期的、慢性的，反义词为 acute（急性的）。

ex.en: The factory was fined for dumping toxic waste into the river.
ex.zh: 该工厂因向河中倾倒有毒废料而被罚款。

words.note: toxic 指有毒的，源自 toxin（毒素），可引申为有害的。

ex.en: Hundreds of students entered the speech contest this year.
ex.zh: 今年有数百名学生参加了演讲比赛。

words.note: contest 作名词重音在前，作动词重音在后，意为质疑。

ex.en: The author spent five years collecting material for the book.
ex.zh: 这位作者花了五年时间为这本书收集素材。

words.note: author 指作者、著作家，比 writer 更正式。

ex.en: He pulled the lever and the heavy door slowly opened.
ex.zh: 他一拉操纵杆，沉重的门慢慢打开了。

words.note: lever 指杠杆，也可喻为施加影响的手段或筹码。

ex.en: The village has worked hard to preserve its traditional culture.
ex.zh: 这个村庄一直努力保护自己的传统文化。

words.note: preserve 强调保持原状、免遭破坏，也可指腌制食物。

ex.en: The two universities established a joint research center last year.
ex.zh: 这两所大学去年成立了一个联合研究中心。

words.note: establish 后接机构、关系、事实等，注意词尾是 -ish。

ex.en: Rapid expansion brought the company new markets and new problems.
ex.zh: 快速扩张给公司带来了新市场，也带来了新问题。

words.note: expansion 来自 expand，注意与 expenditure（支出）区分。

ex.en: He wrenched the door open and rushed out of the burning room.
ex.zh: 他猛地拉开门，冲出燃烧的房间。

words.note: wrench 指猛扭，也指扳手，过去式为 wrenched。

ex.en: Please include only information that is relevant to the question.
ex.zh: 请只写与问题相关的信息。

words.note: relevant 常与 to 连用，反义词为 irrelevant。

ex.en: The company plans to expand into overseas markets next year.
ex.zh: 公司计划明年向海外市场扩张。

words.note: expand 可指规模扩大，也可指气体膨胀，名词为 expansion。

ex.en: She stood at the window and gazed at the falling snow.
ex.zh: 她站在窗前，凝视着飘落的雪花。

words.note: gaze 指长时间凝视，常与 at 连用，比 look 更专注。

ex.en: The government proclaimed a state of emergency after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水过后，政府宣布进入紧急状态。

words.note: proclaim 多用于正式宣布重大事项，比 announce 更庄重。

ex.en: The case was heard by a magistrate in the small town court.
ex.zh: 此案由小镇法庭的一名地方法官审理。

words.note: magistrate 指基层法官或治安官，处理较轻的案件。

ex.en: The program can retrieve data from the server in seconds.
ex.zh: 这个程序能在几秒内从服务器检索数据。

words.note: retrieve 指取回、找回，也指检索数据，名词为 retrieval。

ex.en: Researchers conducted a survey of two thousand college students.
ex.zh: 研究人员对两千名大学生进行了一项调查。

words.note: survey 作名词重音在前，作动词可指审视，重音偏后。

ex.en: Skipping safety checks could jeopardize the lives of the crew.
ex.zh: 跳过安全检查可能会危及机组人员的生命。

words.note: jeopardize 由 jeopardy（危险）加 -ize 构成，意为危及。

ex.en: The neighbors complained that someone was spying on them at night.
ex.zh: 邻居们抱怨有人在夜里监视他们。

words.note: spy 作动词常用 spy on sb，作名词指间谍。

ex.en: Rising sea levels could displace thousands of people along the coast.
ex.zh: 海平面上升可能使沿海数千人被迫迁移。

words.note: displace 指取代或迫使迁离原处，名词为 displacement。

ex.en: Agriculture remains the predominant industry in this part of the country.
ex.zh: 农业仍然是该国这一地区的主导产业。

words.note: predominant 指占主导地位的，名词为 predominance。

ex.en: This soup is easy to make if you follow the recipe carefully.
ex.zh: 只要照着食谱仔细做，这道汤很容易做。

words.note: recipe 指食谱，也比喻方法，a recipe for 后常接灾难。

ex.en: The two parties differ sharply in their political ideology.
ex.zh: 两党在政治意识形态上差异很大。

words.note: ideology 指系统的思想观念体系，常与 political 连用。

ex.en: Schools are paying more attention to students' mental health.
ex.zh: 学校越来越关注学生的心理健康。

words.note: mental 指心理的、精神的，与 physical（身体的）相对。

ex.en: Everyone deserves a decent job and a safe place to live.
ex.zh: 每个人都应有一份像样的工作和安全的住所。

words.note: decent 指还过得去的、得体的，注意别与 descent 混用。

ex.en: The old tent was leaking along every seam after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，旧帐篷的每条接缝都在漏水。

words.note: seam 指缝线、接缝，burst at the seams 指过于拥挤。

ex.en: Police will investigate the cause of the fire in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 警方将调查仓库失火的原因。

words.note: investigate 后直接接宾语，名词为 investigation。

ex.en: The law was passed to end racial discrimination in hiring.
ex.zh: 该法律旨在终止招聘中的种族歧视。

words.note: racial 来自 race（种族），注意与 ethnic（民族的）区分。

ex.en: The mirror created the illusion that the room was twice its size.
ex.zh: 镜子造成假象，仿佛房间大了一倍。

words.note: illusion 指错觉、假象；delusion 指精神上的妄想。

ex.en: The project required a considerable amount of time and money.
ex.zh: 这个项目需要大量的时间和金钱。

words.note: considerable 意为相当大的；considerate 意为体贴的。

ex.en: New machinery greatly increased the factory's productivity last year.
ex.zh: 新机器大大提高了工厂去年的生产率。

words.note: productivity 指生产率，由 productive 加 -ity 构成。
